notes: Master = PokeCottage standard printings (95). Grand = all PokeCottage rows (125) + extended rows (cameos, Topps, vending, other languages). Deduplicated on name/set/num/language/variant; 0 duplicate(s) dropped, listed in merge_notes. Vending Series 2 Ditto #32 kept once (PokeCottage Glossy row); extended duplicate row dropped. Addendum merged Nov 26, 2026: +2 visually-verified cameos (Pikachu 028 30th Celebration, Thought Wave Machine Neo Destiny 096) and the Pikachu ex 149 image. Deliberately NOT merged: Shelmet Fusion Strike 013 (Ditto shape at top-left of art is ambiguous; addendum image URL pointed at Nincada swsh4-13 — correct art is swsh8-13), Influencer's Introduction (no image to verify the blanket claim), Machoke Expansion Sheet 3 (duplicate of the num-67 row), and all 8 Topps rows (same 8 cards as the extended list under different set names).

merge_notes.name: Ditto
merge_notes.notes: Uncommon, on Sheet 3 (Rock Tunnel area). Japanese-only glossy stock. Numbering conflict: PokeCottage standard list uses 32 (pooka.app #32/36); other databases list 132/36 (Pokedex-based). Ditto appears ONLY in Series 2; Series 1 and 3 have no Ditto (Bulbapedia Vending Machine cards page). Image not verified — null.
